participation.context: Paid fourpence halfpenny, answered with a proverb, and asked a price he did not get.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Sold the quire, told the Lambeth news, and would not price the crown paper.
participation.name: Richard Field

relations.note: the quire, and the articles let go

story.body: You bought the quire for fourpence halfpenny, heard the nine articles, and did not write them down.

relations.note: the quire, and the articles let go

title: Paid fourpence halfpenny for the quire

participation.context: Took the quire and wrote nothing.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You took the quire and wrote nothing of the nine articles on it. Crown paper stayed unpriced.

participation.context: Said it once, and left the quire blank.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You kept the weaver and the nine clauses as a thought at home.

title: Thought of the nine clauses and a weaver

story.body: You kept bottom, and you did not keep the letters of the other tongue.
